nodes.name: Recall complete (Webhook)
nodes.notes: Register this URL in Recall.ai dashboard for transcript.done / bot.done.

parameters.formDescription: Paste a transcript / notes from any meeting (Teams, Zoom, Meet, phone) and we'll draft the offer.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "model": "claude-haiku-4-5", "max_tokens": 2000, "system": "You extract structured discovery notes from a sales meeting transcript for S3 Tech. Return ONLY a JSON object: {\"client\":{\"company\":\"\",\"contactName\":\"\",\"contactEmail\":\"\",\"industry\":\"\"},\"meeting\":{\"summary\":\"\",\"painPoints\":[],\"goals\":[],\"constraints\":[],\"budgetSignals\":\"\"}}. Use only facts in the transcript; unknown = empty. Never invent names, emails, or budgets. No markdown.", "messages": [ { "role": "user", "content": $json.transcript } ] } }}

nodes.name: Extract (Haiku · fast)
nodes.notes: Credential 'Anthropic API' = Header Auth: Name 'x-api-key', Value '<anthropic key>'.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "model": "claude-opus-4-8", "max_tokens": 4000, "system": "You are a senior solutions consultant at S3 Tech. From the discovery JSON, produce a personalized service offer. Return ONLY a JSON object with keys client, meeting, offer. Carry client and meeting through. offer must include: title, executiveSummary (2-3 paragraphs), objectives[], scope[] (name, description, deliverables[]), timeline[] (phase, duration, milestones[]), pricing (model, currency EUR, lineItems[{item,quantity,unitPrice,total}], subtotal, taxRate 0.20, tax, total — numbers MUST add up), team[] (role, name empty, bio), assumptions[], terms, validUntil (meeting date + 30 days). No markdown, valid JSON only.", "messages": [ { "role": "user", "content": ("Discovery notes:\n" + JSON.stringify($json.discovery)) } ] } }}

nodes.name: Build review link
nodes.notes: Editor URL baked in. Change ownerEmail to route reviews to the right service owner.

parameters.subject: =Review offer for {{ $json.clientCompany }}

nodes.name: Email owner the review link
nodes.notes: Credential 'Zoho SMTP' = SMTP: smtp.zoho.com:587, user ytiemani@zohomail.com, the app password.

nodes.name: Render PDF (PDFShift)
nodes.notes: Credential 'PDFShift API' = Basic Auth: User 'api', Password '<pdfshift api key>'. Renders the offer HTML to an A4 PDF (binary 'data'). Set sandbox:true while testing to avoid spending credits (adds a watermark).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "title": ($('Use edited offer').item.json.offer.offer.title || 'S3 Tech proposal'), "recipients": [ { "name": $('Use edited offer').item.json.offer.client.contactName, "email": $('Use edited offer').item.json.offer.client.contactEmail, "role": "SIGNER" } ] } }}

nodes.name: Documenso · create document
nodes.notes: Credential 'Documenso API' = Header Auth: Name 'Authorization', Value 'Bearer <documenso token>'. Returns {documentId, uploadUrl} — confirm field names vs your Documenso version.
